name: AlertKick
description:
AlertKick is an infrastructure monitoring and security platform for websites, servers, containers, and endpoints. This connector gives Claude direct access to your AlertKick workspace so you can ask questions and take action in natural language instead of switching to the dashboard.

Key capabilities:
- Servers: list monitored servers and hosts, check status/uptime/OS info, and inspect running Docker containers
- Alerts: list, view, acknowledge, and resolve alerts
- Security events: review eBPF-based security detections and aggregate statistics
- Monitors: create and manage HTTP/API, DNS, TCP, and domain-expiry uptime monitors, including TLS certificate expiry checks; pause, resume, or delete monitors
- Heartbeats: create and manage heartbeat checks for cron jobs and scheduled tasks, including enabling/disabling and deleting
- Incidents: list and review incident details and timelines
- Change management: create, approve, start, complete, and verify change requests, including opening and closing maintenance windows on target servers

The hosted connector at https://mcp.alertkick.com/mcp uses OAuth 2.1 (PKCE, dynamic client registration, RFC 8414/9728 discovery) to connect to your AlertKick workspace - no API keys required. A local stdio binary is also available for self-managed API-key based setups.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AlertKick to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AlertKick to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.alertkick.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AlertKick MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AlertKick lists 34 MCP tools, including acknowledge_alert, approve_change, complete_change, create_change, create_dns_monitor, create_domain_expiry_monitor, create_heartbeat, create_https_monitor, create_monitor, create_tcp_monitor, delete_heartbeat, and delete_monitor.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AlertKick?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AlertKick in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
AlertKick requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AlertKick is developed by AlertKick. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
